Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
// PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT: 40, not the template 60: at ~28% stdcell utilization 60 packed all logic into the left ~55% of the die around the SRAMs; run 45498815170 (6397ff6) ended global routing with 178 Metal2/3 overflows and detailed routing with 3 unfixable shorts across SRAM1 (126 KLayout M3.b). Lower density spreads cells over the empty right side.
// PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 80: 80 (user, 2026-11-27): the mesh chip's effective utilization (0.59 flop store, ~0.41 latch store) is at or above 40, so the old spreading target no longer applies; the flop run at 40 reported 63% placement utilization and global-routing overflow 1,463.
// 92068bf: Moving bank 1 next to bank 0 (x=235.44) at density 60 did not route: detailed routing still had 806 violations after 43 iterations and hit the 6 h CI limit (run 45526662215). Keep the 10f2416 placement, which signed off; the 5x3 grid raises effective utilization from 0.26 to about 0.33, still under 40.
//: CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Two routed runs at 0.1 ns post-GRT hold margin failed the fast-corner hold check.
Use 0.25 ns to leave room for delay changes during detailed routing.
Setup margin and a post-route repair pass. Signoff gates only the typical
corner, but these let the resizer also close the slow corner (1.08 V, 125 C),
which otherwise lost about 0.5 ns to routing after the post-CTS repair.
// DRT_OPT_ITERS: Fail fast when detailed routing cannot converge. Good runs (d628e18 and earlier) finish detailed routing with 0 violations by iteration 2-3; every run since 7193f31 sat at ~540 violations through iteration 55 and hit the 6 h CI limit with no artifacts. 20 iterations ends a non-converging run in about 2 h with its logs and reports.
//: The 72ffb64 route had +3.278 ns slow-corner setup slack, so the 1 ns
post-GRT target left its long pin-to-shifter path untouched. Try 5 ns
to make setup repair address that path before detailed routing.
Slew and capacitance. The only design repair ran after placement, on
estimated wires, so nets that routed longer (1x gates on the CRC residue
compare, fanout buffers, the SRAM's weak DOUT pins) ended up over the
limits at signoff (2945e58: 26 slew, 15 cap). Repair again on the global
route with a wider margin, and buffer any wire over 400 um on the 8x4 die.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
